gallery.title: File:Donated Goods Collection (51817280429).jpg
gallery.artist: Metropolitan Transportation Authority of the State of New York from United States of America
gallery.description:
MTA provides a bus from the West Farms Depot on Tue., January 11, 2022 to ferry donated goods collected at the Angelo Patri school to a distribution point on Webster Ave. for the residents affected by a fire at 333 East 181st St. on January 9. The fire took the lives of 17 residents and injured dozens more.

(Marc A. Hermann / MTA)
categories: Bus stops in the Bronx, New York City
Flickr images taken by the Metropolitan Transportation Authority (New York)
New Flyer XN40 bus of MTA RBO (728)
